plain: Given a quality, gift or right

webster.text: Furnished with a portion of estate; having dower settled on; supplied with a permanent fund; indued.

example.quote: Ought their Religions to be endowed above all others with extraordinary privileges by which proselytes may be enticed from all others?
example.cite: James Madison, Memorial and Remonstrance Against Religious Assessments, c. June 20, 1785
